title: Provider Governance Bulk Review
problem: Global Metadata Candidate Review discovery now exists, but operators still need batch governance that preserves single-review stale guard, idempotency, root-only application, and redaction semantics.
gates: JSONL validation for docs/workstreams/provider-governance-bulk-review/TASKS.jsonl, CAMPAIGNS.jsonl, and CONTEXT.jsonl
cargo nextest run -p nako-server candidate_review admin --no-fail-fast
browser smoke if a route or navigation mode is added

evidence.summary: Opened the Provider Governance bulk review lane after PRGQ closeout and selected a read-only Admin API batch Candidate Review application plan as the first executable task.

Shipped the read-only Admin API batch Candidate Review application plan with bounded selection, deterministic duplicate rejection, generated Admin contract sync, and no-write redaction-safe route evidence.

Shipped bounded synchronous Admin API batch Candidate Review confirmation through the existing single-review application authority, with row-level partial results, replay/noop evidence, generated Admin contract sync, and root-only mutation proof.

Shipped Web Admin global queue selection, read-only batch plan inspection, explicit batch confirmation, redaction-safe partial result rendering, route-state contract coverage, and browser smoke evidence.
Closed the lane and split durable execution, related hierarchy application, provider endpoint depth, Public Client API exposure, and broader audit/undo governance into proposed follow-ons.
